rule_summary: The policyholder gets a period to review the policy terms and conditions and may cancel if not satisfied, subject to applicable deductions.
time_limit: 30 days from receipt of policy document

rule_summary: Policyholders can register complaints with the insurer and escalate unresolved grievances through IRDAI Bima Bharosa.
time_limit: 15 days for the insurer grievance response as described in the grievance process
who_to_contact: Insurer GRO, IRDAI Bima Bharosa, or Insurance Ombudsman as applicable
